day_shape: 96 items: US Treasury moves to sever Banque Misr UAE from dollar system and State Dept sanctions Bank Melli Dubai manager under Operation Economic Outcast, Khamenei issues Government Week message declaring harm to social cohesion 'forbidden', IDF strike in Jenin kills Hamas commander Qais Bitawi plus two, Kremlin confirms Putin-Pezeshkian meeting 1 September.

threads.label: US economic campaign targets Iran dollar access
threads.summary: The US Treasury proposed revoking Banque Misr UAE's US correspondent banking access as a 'critical node' in Iran's dollar access, and State Department sanctioned Reza Mohammad Taeedi, manager of Bank Melli's Dubai branch, under Operation Economic Outcast. Iran International reported Iran's fresh crude exports near zero per Kpler, while the WSJ said Iranian banks continue operating in Dubai despite Washington's D-Day campaign.

threads.label: Khamenei Government Week message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a Government Week message declaring that 'committing anything that harms social cohesion is forbidden' and rejecting false war-or-negotiation dichotomies, with the text amplified across IRIB and Defa Press. Parliament Speaker Qalibaf and the National Security Council Secretary echoed the unity theme, and President Pezeshkian said internal cohesion enabled resistance.

threads.label: Pezeshkian televised address on economy
threads.summary: In a televised Government Week address, President Pezeshkian said imports and exports had fallen 25–35%, admitted the government could not raise cost-of-living allowances as intended, and said 90 million barrels of oil were sold during accord implementation. He said the government would explore remote-working for some bodies and pledged to raise allowances for some income deciles.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Jenin and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said a drone strike in Jenin killed Hamas operative Qais Bitawi, head of Hamas activity in the Jenin refugee camp, together with two other operatives. Separate strikes in Gaza City's Shati and Sabra areas killed Hamas commander Ibrahim Nabil Bass, who took part in the 7 October 2023 attack, and Islamic Jihad platoon commander Hamdi Kahlil.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and regional realignment
threads.summary: IRIB reported IRGC Navy statements calling 'Islamic fighters' control' of the Strait of Hormuz 'absolutely decisive' and rejecting US officials' statements that the waterway remains open, while Foreign Minister Araghchi said regional states realised relying on US security was a mistake. Iran International reported Persian Gulf states are investing billions in ports, pipelines and railways to bypass Hormuz after the Iran war, while the Jerusalem Post noted Iran, Egypt and Bangladesh interest in the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement.

threads.label: Putin-Pezeshkian meeting and negotiations signals
threads.summary: Defa Press cited a Russian presidential aide confirming Putin will meet Pezeshkian on 1 September, and IRIB carried Medvedev dismissing US claims of 'Iran's defeat'. Iran International reported Mohsen Rezaei set out four Iranian conditions for a US deal, and Pezeshkian said Iran would not act on commitments if the other side did not.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressures and UK case
threads.summary: Iran International reported an Iranian court sentenced a 27-year-old mechanic to death for alleged Mossad cooperation and moharebeh per Hengaw, and reported Iranians selling reserved burial plots to cover living costs. A British-Iranian man accused of offering services to the IRGC Quds Force will face trial in 2027 after an undercover operation involving a bag he believed contained a drone.

events.title_en: Sheikh Naim Qassem: The Palestinian issue should be the axis of Islamic Ummah unity
events.summary_en: Sheikh Naim Qassem: The Palestinian issue should be the axis of Islamic Ummah unity. Hezbollah Lebanon's Secretary-General, on the occasion of the birthday of Prophet Muhammad and Unity Week, at the central prophetic festival held by Hezbollah in the southern suburbs of Beirut, said: The Palestinian issue is an Islamic, national, Arab, and human issue and should be the axis of Islamic Ummah unity. The desired Islamic unity is the unity that leads to the power and security of Muslims and achieves development and cooperation amongst them, especially between governments and peoples. The desired Islamic unity is for the liberation of the Ummah from dependence and self-loss and to confront fitna and sectarian, religious and political obstacles. The Palestinian issue should be the axis of Islamic Ummah unity.
